List project pages#

get/v1/projects/{id}/pages

Requires page.list. Lists pages with pagination and optional purpose/name filters. Each item includes its payload and nullable page-owned link; projectId is omitted from list items.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 20

purposestring

Valores: landing, checkout

namestring
Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/pages" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas

Create a project page#

post/v1/projects/{id}/pages

Requires page.create. Creates a page and its single-variant link. An omitted pathname is generated from the name; an explicitly occupied pathname returns 409. Checkout pages require a sales platform from the same project.

Create a page from an HTML or ZIP upload#

post/v1/projects/{id}/pages/upload

Requires page.update. Creates an HTML page and its link from an .html/.htm file or a ZIP bundle. A single HTML upload is stored as index.html. File and archive limits are server-configured. Form errors return 400; path parameter validation returns 422. Checkout purpose requires salesPlatformId; other purposes reject it.

salesPlatformIdstring (uuid)

Queue an HTML page clone#

post/v1/projects/{id}/pages/clone

Requires page.create. Creates a pending HTML page and its link, then queues cloning of an HTTP(S) source URL. HTTP 202 means accepted, not completed. Poll the page payload cloneStatus to observe processing, ready or failed. Returns 503 when the clone worker is unavailable.

Create a builder page from catalog blocks#

post/v1/projects/{id}/pages/compose

Requires page.create. Creates a builder page (editable later in the Trackup builder) from blocks of listPageBlocks; it is a draft until publishPage. page: { title, description?, basedOnPreset?, theme?: { primary: "#RRGGBB", accent?, mode: "light" | "dark" }, blocks: [{ type, overrides?: { fields?: { "<field path>": "text" }, items?: [{ "<item key>": "text" }] } }] }. Field paths and item keys come from the block in listPageBlocks; texts longer than a field max are cut. A preset supplies its sections and a block of the same type replaces the preset one. Content that cannot be placed is listed in warnings.

Publish a project page#

post/v1/projects/{id}/pages/{pageId}/publish

Requires page.update. Builder pages are rendered from their saved document (the same HTML the Trackup builder publishes). HTML pages publish from stored raw files and must have an HTML entry and a ready clone status when present. Redirect pages cannot be published through this operation. Returns url, where the page is served (primary project domain + page pathname). Storage must be configured.

Edit a builder page with patches#

post/v1/projects/{id}/pages/{pageId}/patches

Requires page.update. Applies up to 30 patches to a builder page and saves it; call publishPage again to update the live page. Node ids come from getPage (payload.tree). Operations: set-prop { nodeId, key, value }; set-style { nodeId, key, value } (CSS property in camelCase); replace-subtree { nodeId, node }; insert-child { parentId ("__root__" for a new section), index, node }; remove-node { nodeId }; move-node { nodeId, newParentId, newIndex }; set-theme { key: primary | accent, value } (mode is not applied to saved pages); patch-page-settings { seo?, customCss?, scripts?, preconnectUrls? }. A node is { type, props?, styles?, children? } with type one of: badge, button, container, divider, feature-line, grid, heading, icon, image, spacer, text, video. Text lives in props (heading.text, text.content as HTML, button.label, image.src/alt, badge.text). Rejected patches are explained in warnings.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
pageIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

patchesobject[]obrigatório
opstringobrigatório

Valores: set-prop, set-style, replace-subtree, insert-child, remove-node, move-node, set-theme, patch-page-settings

Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/pages/{pageId}/patches" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "patches": [
    {
      "op": "set-prop"
    }
  ]
}'
Respostas

Saved page, applied patch count and warnings.

Edit an HTML page text file with find-and-replace#

patch/v1/projects/{id}/pages/{pageId}/files

Requires page.update. Applies edits in order to a text file and clears publication. Each oldText must occur exactly once when applied, else 422 and nothing is written: EDIT_TEXT_AMBIGUOUS, or EDIT_TEXT_NOT_FOUND with nearText (file text where the closest partial match starts).

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
pageIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

pathstringobrigatório
editsobject[]obrigatório
oldTextstringobrigatório
newTextstringobrigatório
Exemplo
curl -X PATCH "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/pages/{pageId}/files" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "path": "string",
  "edits": [
    {
      "oldText": "string",
      "newText": "string"
    }

Read an HTML page file#

get/v1/projects/{id}/pages/{pageId}/files/content

Requires page.read. Text files, including SVG, return a JSON object containing path, contentType and content. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, ICO and AVIF return the raw image bytes with their MIME type. Unsupported file extensions, invalid relative paths or a missing path query return 400.

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
pageIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Upload an individual HTML page file#

post/v1/projects/{id}/pages/{pageId}/files/upload

Requires page.update. Writes a raw file up to 10 MiB, adds it to the bundle, updates public assets/HTML as needed and clears publication. The optional trimmed path defaults to the original filename.

List HTML page versions#

get/v1/projects/{id}/pages/{pageId}/versions

Requires page.read. Newest first. Every change to the files of an HTML page (edit, upload, rename, delete, replace, restore) creates a version; the 50 newest are kept, plus the latest published one. Pages changed before versions existed start their history at their next change. Other page types return 400.

List blocks for composing builder pages#

get/v1/page-blocks

Requires page.read. Lists the page sections (hero, features, pricing, FAQ, footer...) available to composeBuilderPage: what each block is for, the field paths it accepts in overrides.fields, and for repeater blocks the shape of overrides.items. Presets are ready-made section sequences. The catalog is large; filter by category when possible.

Parâmetros de consulta

categorystring

Return only blocks of one section kind (hero, pricing...); the full catalog is large.

Valores: content, comparative, cta, download, social, faq, feature, footer, incentives, hero, integration, navbar, pricing, review, stats, team

Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/page-blocks" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
